note: Line-coverage floors for the modules that carry privacy, delivery and
mutation behaviour. A floor, not a target: it may only ever be raised, and
it is raised deliberately when a change earns it. Enforced by
scripts/Test-CoverageFloors.ps1, which the local quality gate runs.
Why these files and not a workspace percentage. A single number over 96
files moves for reasons that have nothing to do with what this project
promises -- add a struct with a Debug impl and it drifts -- so it can only
ever be set low enough to be meaningless or high enough to fail on unrelated
work. These are the files where a regression is a broken promise: whether a
transcript reaches the right window, whether one into a password field is
stored, whether a control that refused says so, and whether the model's
Each value is the measured figure at the time it was pinned, rounded down to
a whole percent. A file named here and absent from the report is a failure,
not a skip: a floor over something nobody measured guards nothing.
The gate prints the headroom on every run, so raising a floor is a visible
act rather than something to remember. Raise it when the headroom is real.
